title: People's Daily Overseas Edition profiles the X-Institute cohort
excerpt: The May 28, 2025 People's Daily piece 从'零'到'一' 破界创新（学创天地）profiled Shenzhen X-Institute students, framing Wu's path from undergraduate uncertainty to interdisciplinary research.
caption: First national-tier feature; later republished by Tsinghua University's news portal.

title: Tsinghua University news portal republishes the People's Daily piece
excerpt: Tsinghua University's official news portal carried the People's Daily Overseas Edition feature in 2025, extending its visibility beyond newspaper distribution.
caption: Adds an institutional layer of confirmation to the X-Institute fellowship narrative.

title: AGU 2023 — Hunga–Tonga in the MLT region
excerpt: Wu, K., Liu, H.-L., Yi, W., & Xue, X. (2023). Perturbations by the 2022 Hunga-Tonga Volcano Eruption in the MLT Region Investigated Using the WACCM-X Simulation and Meteor Radar Observations. AGU Fall Meeting Abstracts, SA33B-2892.
caption: First-author conference work from the NSF NCAR visiting-scholar period.

title: JGR: Space Physics — Mengcheng meteor radar paper
excerpt: Wu, K., Yi, W., Xue, X., Reid, I. M., & Lu, M. (2024). Diurnal and seasonal variations of meteor speed and arrival angle observed by Mengcheng meteor radar. JGR: Space Physics, 129(10), e2024JA032767.
caption: First first-author peer-reviewed publication; closes the USTC undergraduate research arc.

title: AMS 2026 — Plant hydraulics in Noah-MP
excerpt: Wu, K., Li, L., Rempe, D., Matheny, A. M., Mbarak, M., & Yang, Z.-L. (2026). How Does Integrating Plant Hydraulics Improve Noah-MP Land Surface Model. 106th AMS Annual Meeting.
caption: First conference paper from the UT Austin chapter, with co-authors Yang, Rempe, and Matheny.

title: NSF NCAR Allocation UTAA0012 on Derecho-GPU
excerpt: Project Administrator on NSF NCAR allocation UTAA0012 — 'Explainable AI for Improving Physics-Based Noah-MP Land Surface Modeling of Plant–Rock–Water Interactions.' Significant HPC time on the NSF NCAR Derecho-GPU supercomputer.
caption: The active research vehicle behind the present research direction.

title: Mango TV / Hunan TV — 《夺金2026》Episode 1
excerpt: March 2, 2026 broadcast follows university student entrepreneurs in Austin, Texas. Wu appears around the 25:25 mark.
caption: Third national-tier media feature in roughly twelve months.
